name: future-electronics-mcp
description: Look up Future Electronics parts, stock, lead times, and price breaks by manufacturer part number.
long_description: An MCP server for the Future Electronics Product Information API. It looks up one part or a whole bill of materials by manufacturer part number and returns stock, lead time, and price breaks. Pricing matches the Future website and is not an official quote. You need a Future Electronics API license key.

tools.name: future_lookup_part
tools.description: Look up one part by manufacturer part number: stock, lead time, and price breaks.

tools.name: future_lookup_parts
tools.description: Look up many parts at once, such as a BOM, with the best offer and price for each.

future_api_key.title: Future Electronics API key
future_api_key.description: Your Future Electronics license key, from https://www.futureelectronics.com/api-solutions. Claude Desktop stores it securely.

workspace_dir.title: Workspace folder
workspace_dir.description: The one folder where the server reads BOM files and writes exports. It never reads or writes files outside it. The folder is created the first time something is saved there.
